_comment: House ads for the owner's own books. Add another object to 'books' to show a second book; the block renders every entry in order. Only use details from the real Amazon listing. Put the plain Amazon URL in 'url'; These are the owner's own books, so build_site.py links them to the plain amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> URL with NO Associates tag. Set "hidden": true on a book to keep its data but not show it. An entry with "coming_soon": true renders a teaser card (no link, no cover) with a button to the newsletter signup.

books.title: 2027 Planner: January - December
